import abc
import unittest


class CacheTest(unittest.TestCase):
    test_noncallable = 42

    def test_z(self):
        pass

    def test_a(self):
        pass

    def test_hidden(self):
        raise AssertionError("method __test__ false must stay uncollected")

    test_hidden.__test__ = False


class DerivedCache(CacheTest):
    def test_b(self):
        pass


class ConstructorCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def __init__(self, methodName):
        super().__init__(methodName)

    def test_required_constructor_argument(self):
        pass


class RunOnly(unittest.TestCase):
    def runTest(self):
        pass


class HiddenCase(unittest.TestCase):
    __test__ = False

    def test_hidden_class(self):
        raise AssertionError("class __test__ false must stay uncollected")


class InheritedHidden(HiddenCase):
    pass


class ResurrectedCase(HiddenCase):
    __test__ = True

    def test_hidden_class(self):
        pass


class AbstractCase(unittest.TestCase, abc.ABC):
    @abc.abstractmethod
    def test_abstract(self):
        pass


AliasCase = CacheTest


def load_tests(loader, tests, pattern):
    raise AssertionError("pytest does not implement unittest load_tests")
